component.name: Open Hardware Control
component.summary: Open-source hardware control for Linux by Frelidon

description.p: Open Hardware Control is an independent open-source Linux application for controlling and monitoring supported PC hardware from one interface.

ul.li: NZXT Kraken cooling, pump, radiator fans, RGB and LCD controls
LCD images, GIF playback, live hardware dashboards and layered LCD designs
Corsair hardware through the local OpenLinkHub service
Guided local Wallpaper Engine for KDE library, verified Fedora plugin setup and Plasma playback controls
RGB Studio using a loopback-only OpenRGB SDK connection
Safety-gated motherboard and case fan control through Linux hwmon/NCT6687
Profiles, hardware detection, diagnostics and safety-oriented device handoffs

description.p: This is an unofficial independent community project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially supported by NZXT, Corsair, OpenLinkHub, OpenRGB or other hardware vendors mentioned by the application.

screenshot.caption: Cooling control for pump and radiator fans
RGB Studio and supported lighting devices
NZXT Kraken LCD controls and previews

description.p: @CHANNEL@ build with guided Wallpaper Engine setup, a SHA256-verified opt-in Fedora plugin installer, stable gallery sizing, the requested default navigation order and the existing coordinated LCD/RGB hardware paths.
